issue.title: CLI fails to add form component on SvelteKit 3 due to @sveltejs/kit 3.x peer mismatch in sv
issue.body:
Running `npx shadcn-svelte@latest add form` inside a fresh SvelteKit 3 project (`@sveltejs/kit@3.0.1`) crashes during the automatic dependency installation phase with an `npm ERESOLVE` error.

The error occurs because `sveltekit-superforms@2.31.0` defines `peer @sveltejs/kit@"1.x || 2.x"`, which rejects `@sveltejs/kit@3.0.1`. Consequently, `formsnap@2.0.1` (which depends on superforms) cannot be resolved by npm during the CLI execution.

issue.title: perf(docs): parse LLM build HTML once
issue.body:
## Summary

Parse each rendered docs page once when generating LLM Markdown. The previous JSDOM pass and rehype pass parsed the same HTML twice. Remove the now-unused direct `jsdom` and `@types/jsdom` dependencies from docs. This PR stays in draft for review.

## Local measurement

Four alternating runs on the same machine and checkout, with `CI=true` and the repo-pinned pnpm 10.32.1:

| Command | Before mean | After mean | Relative change |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Full docs build (`pnpm build`) | 40.95 s | 37.05 s | 9.5% faster |
| LLM generator (`pnpm -F docs build:llms`) | 7.59 s | 2.83 s | 62.7% faster |

Run order was before / after / after / before. These are local wall-clock measurements, not CI timing claims. The generator produced identical SHA-256 hashes for all 105 generated Markdown and `llms.txt` outputs in every run. After removing `jsdom`, a fresh full build still generated those same 105 hashes.

## Validation

- Full docs build, `pnpm lint`, and `pnpm check` passed after dependency removal.
- A frozen pnpm install passed; the docs package no longer links `jsdom` or `@types/jsdom`.
- The build script also passes a direct TypeScript check (the docs `svelte-check` configuration does not include scripts).
- The branch includes current upstream `main` (`9ebdb0bbc`).

issue.title: [BUG] Dialog and Sheet briefly reappear after their exit animation (Vega)
issue.body:
### Describe the bug

Closing Dialog or Sheet with the generated Vega styles produces a visible stutter at the end of the exit animation. The element fades out, then briefly returns to full opacity before it unmounts. It should stay invisible until removal.

In a frame-by-frame measurement of Sheet, opacity was 0.00389 at 177 ms, approximately 0 at 194 ms, then 1 at 211 ms while the element was still connected. It was removed by 227 ms.

Adding `data-closed:fill-mode-forwards` alongside `data-closed:animate-out` in dialog-content.svelte, dialog-overlay.svelte, sheet-content.svelte, and sheet-overlay.svelte fixes this locally. After the change, both components and both overlays reached opacity 0 without rebounding, then unmounted.

This appeared after updating dependencies/components, but I have not isolated a particular dependency release as the cause.

### Reproduction

Reproduced locally with the exact versions in System Info; no hosted reproduction is included.

1. In a SvelteKit project configured with shadcn-svelte's Vega style, add the Dialog and Sheet components. Keep the generated animation classes unchanged.
2. Render the standard Sheet example with a trigger, content, header, title, and description.
3. Open it, let the opening animation finish, then click the X close button. The exit briefly jumps back to the visible state before unmounting.
4. Repeat with Dialog.
5. Add `data-closed:fill-mode-forwards` alongside `data-closed:animate-out` in both components' content and overlay files. The opacity rebound disappears.

The measured Sheet frames and the verified workaround are in the description above.
